<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rebound:</strong> The Sensex surged 776 points and the Nifty neared the 24,000 mark as a sharp decline in crude oil prices and positive corporate earnings sentiment ended a five-day market correction.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

  <li><strong>Crude oil impact:</strong> Brent crude prices retreated over 4%, providing significant relief to the Indian rupee and domestic bond markets by easing inflationary concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPREo0N0gwZF9WbndhVmxycGFteHdsa2ZEQ1BCUV85TVdKLTRfdlBYb0tlQnY4SzNCdHh2dEloR2k4QWFuYlNYazRucHZGa1dxOHNNdGYzcmo1M1BEUExzZGlBMm45WUJHTU1RYUxOZ3RvT2w2MU1yTUpWQUthRzdOLUJ0bHVBeHJLSmNYcVZkS3F6eVplb0NSelcxek54UXkxaHd4QXVzRWIyRVBVczEzbUhETHZzOTIyZWtHdEt3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
